messages.text:
Created [DES-004 muon input](docs/design/inputs/DES-004-muon.md).

It distinguishes standalone, vertex-constrained and combined measurements; retains toroidal and instrumented-return investigations; documents the MAG-03 station conflict, forward coverage, scattering and service requirements.

**Checks:** 30 session records and dashboard validation passed. No field or performance claims added; no commits or shared-file edits.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
